zh: 改善主题外观为《The Fire Rises》长征姬的霓虹赛博风格：绯红与青霓两张色卡、深紫黑画布、红金五角星徽记与窄体技术字体，输入卡片上沿的吉祥物改为长征姬与大肥鱼两只像素角色。
en: Improve the theme's look to the neon cyber style of The Fire Rises' Long March girl: crimson and cyan colour cards, deep violet canvases, a red-gold star emblem and condensed technical lettering, with the pixel Long March girl and Big Fish as the two composer mascots.
